text:
deploy-bot: Canary evaluation failed for rollout r-2026-04-12-21: error_rate (5m) crossed threshold (3%) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Paging on-call: @sasha (SRE) — severity: P1 — reason: canary error rate spike + 5xx increase
sasha: On it. pulling logs now, opening thread.
eng-sre: saw elevated 503s on /v1/generate from canary hosts, latency p95 jumped to 2.1s. Possible route misconfig + new batching config.
maria: Confirmed. Errors mostly from model shard pool OOM on canary units after qkv change. A small subset of requests are failing fast with `kv_cache_miss` in logs.
ashley: Product note: Support is getting 4 escalations, one enterprise tenant seeing 8% 5xx. We should assess customer impact and TTR.
product-ops: Notifying CS and assigned a customer-impact ticket #INC-4321, marking as degraded for Hosted API customers in us-west-2.
sasha: Attempting automated rollback via `deployctl rollback --service inference --to-tag r-2026-04-11-09` now.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback attempt started (id: rb-7743).
deploy-bot: Automated rollback failed: preflight hook `db-lock-check` returned non-zero (0x2).
eng-sre: preflight hook blocked because an in-flight migration lock present on config-db, likely from evening maintenance. Do NOT force migration unlock without approval.
ashley: We need a fast mitigation. Can we flip feature flag `ff.new-routing` to off as a kill-switch? That would divert traffic away from canary path.
maria: Yes, `ff.new-routing` controls the canary routing. I can flip it via console. Doing it in 30s.
infra-bot: api:featureflag - set `ff.new-routing` = false (who=maria) - ok
sasha: Observing traffic shift. Canary hosts drop to 0% traffic in 40s. 5xx rate dropping. p95 latency falling back toward baseline.
eng-sre: Great. Start manual rollback plan while we monitor. Since auto-rollback blocked by migration, we'll do manual service rollback without migration hooks: coord with infra to pull canary instances and redeploy previous image.
maria: Rolling previous image `r-2026-04-11-09` to canary pool: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/canary inference=image-registry/redwood:r-2026-04-11-09 --record`. Running now.
ashley: I'll notify CS that we've applied a kill-switch and are rolling back; asking them to hold CS escalations for 15m.
eng-sre: `kubectl rollout status deploy/canary` -> current: 3/3 updated. Health checks passing.
sasha: Smoke tests: `/health`, sample generate with prompt length 64, and embeddings smoke — all returned success. Token latency p95 back to 350ms. 5xx rate for Hosted API in us-west-2 down to baseline (0.6%).
product-ops: Customer-impact note: enterprise tenant still reported one failed job; CS handling. Overall impact: ~1.2k requests failed during window, ~0.8% of total traffic for the hour.
maria: Canaries fully drained, old canaries terminated. Re-enable `ff.new-routing` only after postmortem decisions. Leaving flag off for now.
sasha: Marking incident mitigated. Will open postmortem and assign to service owners: @maria (runtime), @eng-sre, @deploy-bot for rollout flow.
product-ops: Postmortem ticket created: PM-1187. Preliminary cause: batching/config change combined with canary routing mismatch and migration preflight preventing automated rollback.
ashley: Follow-up actions: (1) change preflight hook to be non-blocking for rollback path if migration locked, (2) add automated kill-switch when canary error_rate > 2x baseline, (3) add a canary traffic mirror to reduce blast radius.
sasha: Pushing a short summary to #incidents-log and notifying oncall rotation. Good job all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Incident closed (rb-7743) — duration: 00:24:39
product-ops: CS status: customer escalations de-escalated.
eng-sre: Adding timestamps and logs to postmortem.
maria: I'll follow up with a small PR to revert qkv opt change for canary until we validate memory profile.
ashley: Thanks team.
